capabilities: Store cases, legislation and secondary sources in one vault file
Export to Word with real footnotes and AGLC4 headings, typography and bibliography
Apply a reference Word document's styles to exports
Expose an API that other plugins extend
Show stored authorities, registered extensions and the default template in settings
disambiguation: Not a legal research or citation tool on its own; it is a shared authority store and export engine that other plugins build on.
extras: Does little visible on its own; plugins built on it require it and warn when it is missing or too old. Works locally with no network requests, AI or telemetry; API documented in API.md with an example plugin in examples/case-notes.
problem: Legal plugins had no single shared store of the cases, legislation and sources a practice relies on, and no common Word export engine they could all use.
summary: Shared foundation for Australian legal plugins that stores cases, legislation and sources in one vault file and provides an AGLC4 Word export engine.
